clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, reports of Blackwood aggression reach the village elder. Terenthis sends you to Thundris Windweaver with news of the furbolgs’ growing hostility. Thundris seeks the cause of the corruption spreading through Darkshore.

After scouting corrupted furbolg camps in Darkshore, you carry Terenthis’s report to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine. Terenthis remains in the wilds to investigate the spreading corruption. As village elder, Thundris oversees the settlement’s daily welfare and considers the spiritual and environmental dangers facing the kaldorei. Your report gives Auberdine’s leadership evidence that the furbolgs are growing more than territorial: an unnatural malice is taking hold of them.

Thundris has heard of rising hostility from the forest dwellers near Auberdine. The furbolgs’ aggression is not the only concern. Corruption is spreading through Darkshore’s soil, plants, and waters. Thundris believes the land cannot be healed until the source of the blight is found. He turns to the waterways and enlists capable allies to trace the taint upstream.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your scouting of the furbolg camp is information that Thundris Windweaver should be made aware of. He graciously serves as the elder of Auberdine, offering sage and just stewardship of the day to day affairs of the village. Please - share with him your findings to date on the furbolg situation.
I believe he has some ideas of his own on the reasons behind their corruption. Perhaps you can work with him to enact a plan to restore the balance of nature here!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well met, adventurer. Your scouting of the furbolg situation comes at a fortuitous time for us in Auberdine. For some time we have dealt with not only forest dwellers who are now openly hostile to our presence, but also the outright corruption of the forest itself. Hopefully you might be able to lend Auberdine aid during these troubling times.
